events.detail_full_zh: 受出云横田站至八川站之间发生竹子倒伏事件的影响，木次站至备后落合站之间的部分列车出现晚点。
events.detail_full_en: Due to fallen trees between Izumo Yokota and Hachikawa stations, some trains on the Kiso-Bingo Ochiai section are experiencing delays.
